europe_now.title: Collapse of COP31 Climate Negotiations
europe_now.summary: Global climate talks collapsed after delegations failed to reach an agreement, with the European Union rejecting the proposed text over the omission of fossil fuel references.

europe_now.title: Maritime Attack and Regional Security in Northern Europe
europe_now.summary: A Russia-bound ship was attacked in the Gulf of Finland, prompting security warnings and subsequent towing operations.

top_stories.title: COP31 Summit Collapse
top_stories.summary: The COP31 climate conference concluded without a binding agreement following intense divisions. Negotiators failed to secure a consensus after the European Union rejected the text for omitting references to fossil fuels.

top_stories.title: Maritime Incidents and Security
top_stories.summary: A Russia-bound vessel sustained damage following an attack in the Gulf of Finland and required towing. Meanwhile, separate reports noted a suspected drone attack hitting a Russian warship at a Libyan naval base.

top_stories.title: Transport Disruptions in Belgium
top_stories.summary: Major airports in Brussels and Charleroi announced the cancellation of most flights ahead of scheduled national industrial action. The transportation strikes are expected to cause widespread travel disruptions across the country.
